a: `heldIndex` does not truncate a fractional index, so `moveLayer` to its own slot records an undo entry
`freshIds` only steps over ids live in the document, so a minted id can collide with a node a restored history will bring back
A journal's `applyOps` records inside `scene.untracked`, where `scene.history.applyOps` throws
An edit that is refused or throws after `kit:remove` applied leaves the removed nodes' scroll offsets and pose previews dropped
b: `loadState` runs with a journal open and leaves that journal holding the replaced document's ops
A stale replay never skips a layer op, so an untracked layer edit leaves an undo entry that throws on every step
A journal opened on `scene.history` records `applyOps` inside `untracked`, which the history facade refuses
`reorder` with an omitted index treats it as "the end" in its no-op check and records "the start"
